title: Best Martial Arts School Software (2026, Sourced Prices)
description: Martialytics, Kicksite, Gymdesk, Zen Planner, Spark Membership, MASS and Mindbody compared on price, belt tracking, attendance and billing.
body:
Most martial arts software prices by active students, so the cheapest tool depends on your headcount and on whether you use the vendor's payment processor. Every number below comes from the vendor's own page; anything not published is marked unknown.

{{table:martialytics,kicksite,gymdesk,zen-planner,spark-membership,mass,mindbody}}

Kicksite: lowest published entry price

$49/mo for 0-25 students, $99 for 26-50, $149 for 51-100, $199 for 101+. All features at every tier, and belt rank and attendance tracking are listed. Discounted annual pricing is available on request. {{aff:kicksite|Visit Kicksite}}

Martialytics: flat tiers, every feature

$69/mo up to 50 students, $99 to 100, $129 to 200, $199 over 200. Unlimited users and locations, a 30-day trial with no card, and standard Stripe rates with no revenue cut (per the vendor). {{aff:martialytics|Visit Martialytics}}

Gymdesk: cheaper with its payments

$75/mo (≤50 active members) with Gymdesk Payments, or $100/mo with your own processor, up to $200/$240 for 151-250 members. Includes a gym website and unlimited staff. 30-day trial. {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}}

Zen Planner: belt and skill tracking plus payroll

Studio starts at $99/mo, scaled by active members. Belt and skill tracking, staff payroll and member and staff apps are listed. Month-to-month by default. {{aff:zenplanner|Visit Zen Planner}}

Spark Membership: done-for-you setup

An 8-week free trial, then $199/mo, with free data migration and setup by an account rep. Belt history and family accounts are listed. {{aff:sparkmembership|Visit Spark Membership}}

MASS and Mindbody

MASS (Australia-based) doesn't publish prices publicly and charges a 2% platform fee on payments processed through it. Mindbody starts at $79/mo per location but is built mainly for yoga, fitness and wellness studios. We found no belt tracking on its pricing page.

Cost at 40 active students (published prices only)

  • Kicksite: $99/mo
  • Martialytics: $69/mo
  • Gymdesk: $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments, $100 without
  • Zen Planner: from $99/mo (exact price unknown)
  • Spark: $199/mo

See also: BJJ gym software, dance studio software, and all martial arts tools.
faq: Which martial arts software is cheapest?
At 0-25 students, Kicksite's published $49/mo is the lowest entry price we found (kicksite.com/pricing, checked 2026-10-22).
Martialytics, Kicksite, Gymdesk, Zen Planner, Spark Membership and MASS all list belt or rank tracking on their sites. For Mindbody we didn't find it on the pages we checked, so it's marked unknown.
Martialytics and Gymdesk offer 30 days, Spark 8 weeks and MASS 14 days, per their sites.
Which martial arts software prices by student count?
Martialytics, Kicksite, Gymdesk and MASS price by active students or members, and Zen Planner prices by active members (prospects and staff not counted).
